COFFIN capstone shows CV model evaluation and optimization depth beyond just training: TensorRT-optimized YOLO for visual servoing with a 5.2x speedup benchmarked against eager PyTorch
ROS-Based Robotic Arm project (UR5e + AL5B, ROS 2 Humble, MoveIt, RViz) backs the 'things that make a difference' ROS/robotics-framework preference
real_gaps: No experience building production performance dashboards or monitoring fleet-scale metrics — the JD's first essential function ('build and review performance metrics and dashboards of the production and/or pilot fleet') has no direct backing; closest adjacent is a PyQt/Matplotlib lab data-acquisition GUI at BARC, which is single-user/offline scale, not fleet telemetry
No CI/CD or Agile/Scrum exposure anywhere in the profile

No cross-functional customer-facing coordination at company scale — all experience is academic, research, or internship scope; this role explicitly coordinates across hardware/firmware/platform/UX/quality/cloud/autonomy/Applied ML teams to deliver customer value on a live pilot
overstated_by_keywords: 'Design patterns, data structures, advanced programming techniques' was counted as Have based on general CS/M.S. coursework and project breadth, not because any bullet explicitly names a design pattern or algorithm-design exercise
llm_analysis.reasoning: The embedded CV + real-time systems core of this role is an unusually direct match, especially the turret project which combines nearly every required technical element in one system. The main real risk is scope: this is a production customer engineering role built around fleet-scale telemetry and multi-team coordination, and the profile's evidence for that specific slice is thin compared to its technical depth.
